name: Transaction Details 182
definition: Identifies the details of the transaction.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instruments representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies if the movement on a securities account results from a deliver or a receive instruction.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, eg, against payment.

SettlementQuantity.name: Settlement Quantity
SettlementQuantity.definition: Total quantity of securities to be settled.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities.

DigitalPaymentSettlement.name: Digital Payment Settlement
DigitalPaymentSettlement.definition: Total quantity  of digital asset to be paid or received in exchange for the securities token.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

Investor.name: Investor
Investor.definition: Party, either an individual or organisation, whose assets are being invested.
